name: Lead Catcher
blurb: Each website-form or typed-in request becomes one card with an owner and a next step. AIA drafts the reply. A person presses Yes before anything goes out. Email, text and missed call are test only for now.

face.how: Catch the request. Give it an owner and a next step. Confirm the contact. AIA drafts a reply. A person presses Yes on the exact words. Nothing sends alone.

help: One request is one card. The customer's words are kept exactly as they came in.
Every open card has an owner and a next step with a due time. Waiting needs a reason and a follow-up date.
AIA drafts only. A person presses Yes on the exact reply, contact and channel. Any change cancels the Yes.
Stop cancels a Yes before it runs. Closing with no action needs a reason and a second tap.
In this preview, replies go to a test outbox. Nothing is sent to customers. Nothing is charged.

changesDesk.approval: Yes is bound to the exact reply, contact, channel and any commitment. Any change cancels it. Each Yes runs once.

queue.empty: No requests yet. Turn on Lead Catcher, then a form or a typed-in call becomes a card here.
